visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white patterned long-sleeved shirt, stands in a brightly lit modern kitchen. She faces the camera directly, gesturing with her hands while speaking. On the counter in front of her are two bowls: one containing white cooked rice and another with a pale, solid substance (lard). The background features white cabinetry, a stovetop with cookware, and a window reflecting the interior light. (2) The woman picks up a silver spoon and scoops a portion of the white lard from the bowl, demonstrating its texture to the viewer. She smiles and maintains eye contact with the camera. Large yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen, emphasizing her words. The camera is slightly handheld, creating a dynamic, personal vlog-style feel. (3) The scene cuts to a macro close-up of the grey bowl filled with steaming white rice. The woman's hands, with painted fingernails, enter the frame to place a spoonful of lard onto the rice. A vintage-style photo of a woman holding a small child appears as a brief picture-in-picture overlay in the corner. (4) She pours dark soy sauce from a large Kikkoman bottle into the small red cap, then carefully drizzles it over the rice and lard mixture. The lighting remains bright and consistent. She then begins to mix the ingredients vigorously with the spoon, the rice turning a brownish hue as the lard melts and the sauce incorporates. (5) In a fast-paced montage, she transitions to a stovetop. A white frying pan is placed over a blue gas flame. She pours golden cooking oil into the pan, swirls it to coat the surface, and cracks a fresh egg into the center. The camera movements are more energetic, following the cooking process closely. (6) She uses a wooden spatula to flip the frying egg, ensuring it is cooked until the edges are crispy but the yolk remains soft. Once finished, she places the fried egg on top of her bowl of rice. She holds the final dish up to the camera with a satisfied expression. (7) The location shifts to a living room with a beige sofa. A man is seen lying down, resting his head on a pillow. A tabby cat sits prominently on the back of the sofa, watching the man. The woman films from a POV perspective, interacting with the man who looks towards the camera. (8) Back in the kitchen, the woman holds her bowl of lard rice with the fried egg. She waves one hand towards the camera, smiling broadly as she says goodbye. The lighting is warm and domestic, emphasizing a cozy, home-centered atmosphere.

(2) A rhythmic, upbeat pop-style background music enters, characterized by a steady 4/4 beat and bright electronic textures. A sharp "pop" sound effect accompanies the appearance of on-screen text. The female voice becomes more animated and high-pitched, expressing excitement about the nostalgic dish. (3) As she prepares the food, the sound of a metal spoon clinking against a ceramic bowl is clearly audible. The music continues at a consistent volume, blending with her narration. There are occasional short, bright digital UI sound effects that punctuate her sentences. (4) During the egg-frying sequence, the acoustic texture shifts. A crisp, percussive "crack" sound is heard as the egg is broken, followed immediately by the high-frequency sizzling of oil in a hot pan. The background music switches to a faster-tempo, acoustic-driven track with rhythmic guitar strumming. (5) The scene transition brings a change in ambient noise to a more open, living-room floor. The female voice interacts with a male voice, which is deeper in pitch and exhibits a relaxed, lower-arousal tone. The background music lowers in the mix to allow the dialogue to remain prominent. (6) A final digital "ding" or bell-like sound effect marks a transition back to the kitchen. The upbeat music swells slightly in volume. The female voice concludes with a rising intonation, sounding cheerful and inviting as she says her final words to the audience.
